```{r summary_top, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

# ---- Create text data for ignored markers ---- #

ignored_mk_display_list <- list()
if(!is.null(dt_ignore_mk)){
  ignored_markers <- dt_ignore_mk$Marker[dt_ignore_mk$Ignore]
  if(length(ignored_markers) == 0){
    ignored_mk_display_list[[1]] <- "-"
  }else{
    ignored_mk_display <- paste0(ignored_markers, collapse = ", ")
    if(nchar(ignored_mk_display) > 50){
      txt_tmp <- ""
      count <- 1
      bool_remain <- FALSE
      for(i in 1:length(ignored_markers)){
        txt_tmp_new <- paste0(txt_tmp, ignored_markers[i], ", ")
        if(nchar(txt_tmp_new) > 50){
          ignored_mk_display_list[[count]] <- txt_tmp
          txt_tmp <- paste0(ignored_markers[i], ", ")
          count <- count + 1
          bool_remain <- FALSE
        }else{
          txt_tmp <- txt_tmp_new
          bool_remain <- TRUE
        }
      }
      if(bool_remain){
        ignored_mk_display_list[[count]] <- substr(txt_tmp_new, 1, nchar(txt_tmp_new) - 2)
      }else{
        ignored_mk_display_list[[count - 1]] <- substr(ignored_mk_display_list[[count - 1]], 1, nchar(ignored_mk_display_list[[count - 1]]) - 2)
      }
    }else{
      ignored_mk_display_list[[1]] <- ignored_mk_display
    }
  }
}else{
  ignored_mk_display_list[[1]] <- "-"
}

# ---- Create the data.frame for general information and settings ---- #

n_row_ignored_mk <- length(ignored_mk_display_list)
mat_info <- matrix("", 9 + n_row_ignored_mk, 2)
mat_info[, 1] <- c("Case Name", "User", "Date", "KongohPlus version", 
                   "Crime stain profile", "Reference profile", "Allele frequency", 
                   "Analysis method", "Theta", rep("Ignored markers", n_row_ignored_mk))
if(!is.null(case_name)){
  mat_info[1, 2] <- case_name
}
if(!is.null(user_name)){
  mat_info[2, 2] <- user_name
}
mat_info[3, 2] <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
mat_info[4, 2] <- as.character(packageVersion("KongohPlus"))
if(!is.null(fn_csp)){
  mat_info[5, 2] <- fn_csp
}
if(!is.null(fn_ref)){
  mat_info[6, 2] <- fn_ref
}
if(!is.null(fn_af)){
  mat_info[7, 2] <- fn_af
}
if(!is.null(fn_anameth)){
  mat_info[8, 2] <- fn_anameth
}
if(!is.null(theta)){
  mat_info[9, 2] <- theta
}
for(i in 1:n_row_ignored_mk){
  mat_info[9 + i, 2] <- ignored_mk_display_list[[i]]
}

df_info <- as.data.frame(mat_info)
names(df_info) <- c("a", "b")

# ---- Display the created data.table ---- #

kable(df_info, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "11cm")
```

```{r summary_deconvo, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("\\subsection*{Deconvolution}")
  
  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_param <- data_hnc$dt_param
    dt_log10like <- data_hnc$dt_log10like
    opt_list <- data_hnc$opt_list
  
    vec_temp <- rep(NA, 4)
    vec_temp[1:hnc] <- round(dt_param[["Estimated value"]][dt_param[["Parameter"]] == "Template amount"], 2)
  
    vec_mp <- rep(NA, 4)
    vec_mp[1:hnc] <- round(vec_temp[1:hnc] / sum(vec_temp[1:hnc]), 4)
  
    vec_deg <- rep(NA, 4)
    vec_deg[1:hnc] <- round(dt_param[["Estimated value"]][dt_param[["Parameter"]] == "Degradation"], 4)
  
    vec_temp[is.na(vec_temp)] <- "-"
    vec_mp[is.na(vec_mp)] <- "-"
    vec_deg[is.na(vec_deg)] <- "-"
  
    df_param_display <- as.data.frame(cbind(c("Template amount", "Mixture proportion", "Degradation"), rbind(vec_temp, vec_mp, vec_deg)))
    names(df_param_display) <- c("", "U1", "U2", "U3", "U4")
  
  
    vec_rep <- round(dt_param[["Estimated value"]][dt_param[["Parameter"]] == "Replicate amplification efficiency"], 2)
    df_rep_display <- data.frame("Replicate" = as.character(1:length(vec_rep)), 
                                 "Amplification efficiency" = as.character(vec_rep), 
                                 check.names = FALSE)
  
    num_attempt <- length(opt_list)
    if(length(opt_list) == 1){
      count_solution <- 1
    }else{
      current_score <- round(opt_list[[1]]$value, 3)
      count_solution <- 1
      for(i in 2:length(opt_list)){
        new_score <- round(opt_list[[i]]$value, 3)
      
        if(new_score < current_score){
          current_score <- new_score
          count_solution <- 1
        }else if(new_score == current_score){
          count_solution <- count_solution + 1
        }
      }
    }
  
    log10like <- as.character(round(dt_log10like[["Log10_Likelihood"]][dt_log10like[["Marker"]] == "Overall"], 2))
    num_attempt <- as.character(num_attempt)
    count_solution <- as.character(count_solution)
  
    df_convergence_display <- data.frame(a = c("log10(likelihood)", "No. MLE attempts", "No. acceptances"), 
                                         b = c(log10like, num_attempt, count_solution))
  
    cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
    
    tb <- kable(df_param_display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
    tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "4.8cm")
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "2.4cm")
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 3, width = "2.4cm")
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 4, width = "2.4cm")
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 5, width = "2.4cm")
    print(tb)
  
    cat("\\vspace{-2em}\n")
  
    cat(c("\\begin{table}[!htb]
      \\begin{minipage}[t]{.5\\linewidth}
        \\centering
        \\vspace{0pt}",
          kable(df_rep_display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "") %>%
            kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            column_spec(1, width = "3.1cm") %>%
            column_spec(2, width = "4.1cm"), 
      "\\end{minipage}%
      \\begin{minipage}[t]{.5\\linewidth}
        \\centering
        \\vspace{0pt}",
          kable(df_convergence_display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "") %>%
            kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
            column_spec(1, width = "5.6cm") %>%
            column_spec(2, width = "1.6cm"),
      "\\end{minipage} 
    \\end{table}"
    ))
  
    cat("\n\n") # space between tables
  }
}
```

```{r pg_per_comb, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Probabilistic genotyping (per combination)}")
  
  n_mk_use <- length(markers_use)

  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_pg_list <- data_hnc$dt_pg_list
  
    cat(sprintf("\\subsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
  
    for(j in 1:n_mk_use){
      mk <- markers_use[j]
      dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_list[[mk]]
    
      # --- Extract up to the point where the total probability exceeds 'gt_prob_sum' --- #
    
      cumprob <- cumsum(dt_pg_per_comb$Probability)
    
      # Get the first row number where the total exceeds 'gt_prob_sum'
      cutoff_index <- which.max(cumprob > gt_prob_sum)
    
      # If there are no values exceeding 'gt_prob_sum', use all rows.
      if(cutoff_index == 0){
        cutoff_index <- nrow(dt_pg_per_comb$Probability)
      }
    
      # Extract
      dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[1:cutoff_index]
    
      # --- Extract displayed columns --- #
    
      dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[, which(is.element(names(dt_pg_per_comb), c(paste0("U", 1:hnc), "Probability"))), with = FALSE]
    
      # --- Display the table --- #
    
      cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{%s}\n", mk))
    
      tb <- kable(dt_pg_per_comb, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
      tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 1:ncol(dt_pg_per_comb), width = "2.4cm")
      print(tb)
    
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r pg_per_contrib, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Probabilistic genotyping (per contributor)}")
  
  n_mk_use <- length(markers_use)

  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_pg_list <- data_hnc$dt_pg_list
    
    cat(sprintf("\\subsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
  
    for(j in 1:hnc){
    
      dt_pg_per_contrib_all <- NULL
      cut_positions <- rep(NA, n_mk_use)
      
      cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{Contributor %s (U%s)}\n", j, j))
    
      for(k in 1:n_mk_use){
      
        mk <- markers_use[k]
        dt_pg_per_contrib <- aggregate_pg_contrib(dt_pg_list[[mk]], paste0("U", j))
        
        # --- Extract up to the point where the total probability exceeds 'gt_prob_sum' --- #
    
        cumprob <- cumsum(dt_pg_per_contrib$Probability)
        
        # Get the first row number where the total exceeds 'gt_prob_sum'
        cutoff_index <- which.max(cumprob > gt_prob_sum)
    
        # If there are no values exceeding 'gt_prob_sum', use all rows.
        if(cutoff_index == 0){
          cutoff_index <- nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib$Probability)
        }
    
        # Extract
        dt_pg_per_contrib <- dt_pg_per_contrib[1:cutoff_index, ]

        # --- Add a column for the marker --- #
        
        col_mk <- rep("", nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib))
        col_mk[1] <- mk
      
        dt_pg_per_contrib <- cbind(col_mk, dt_pg_per_contrib)
        names(dt_pg_per_contrib)[1] <- "Marker"
        
        dt_pg_per_contrib_all <- rbind(dt_pg_per_contrib_all, dt_pg_per_contrib)
        
        cut_positions[k] <- nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib_all)
      }
      
      names(dt_pg_per_contrib_all) <- c("Marker", "Genotype", "Probability")
      
      cut_positions <- cut_positions[-n_mk_use]
      
      # --- Display the table --- #  
    
      tb <- kable(dt_pg_per_contrib_all, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
      tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 1:ncol(dt_pg_per_contrib_all), width = "2.4cm")
      tb <- row_spec(tb, cut_positions, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule")
      print(tb)
    
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r csp, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(dt_csp)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Crime stain profile}")
  
  sn_csp_all <- unique(dt_csp[, SampleName])
  n_rep <- length(sn_csp_all)
  df_csp_rep <- data.frame("Replicate" = as.character(1:n_rep), 
                           "Sample Name" = sn_csp_all, 
                           check.names = FALSE)

  tb <- kable(df_csp_rep, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
  tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "2.4cm")
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "13.4cm")
  print(tb)
  cat("\n\n")

  dt_display_csp <- create_dt_display_csp(dt_csp)

  dt_display_csp[, g := cumsum(!is.na(Marker))]

  tmp_markers <- dt_display_csp$Marker
  tmp_markers[is.na(tmp_markers)] <- ""
  dt_display_csp$Marker <- tmp_markers

  ends <- dt_display_csp[g > 0, .(end = .I[.N]), by = g]$end
  cut_positions <- if (length(ends) > 1) ends[-length(ends)] else integer(0)

  n_table_csp <- (n_rep - 1) %/% 4 + 1
  for(i in 1:n_table_csp){
    cand_height_label <- paste0("Height", (4 * (i - 1) + 1):(4 * i))
    index_display <- which(is.element(names(dt_display_csp), c("Marker", "Allele", cand_height_label)))
  
    tb <- kable(
      dt_display_csp[, index_display, with = FALSE], 
      format = "latex", 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      longtable = TRUE, 
      row.names = FALSE, 
      align = c("l", rep("r", length(index_display) - 1)), 
      escape = TRUE, 
      float = FALSE, 
      linesep = ""
    )
    tb <- kable_styling(
      tb, 
      latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), 
      position = "left", 
      full_width = FALSE
    )
    tb <- row_spec(
      tb,
      cut_positions, 
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule"
    )
    tb <- column_spec(
      tb, 
      1:length(index_display), 
      width = "2.4cm"
    )
    print(tb)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r ref, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(dt_ref)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Reference profile}")
  
  dt_ref_display <- NULL
  samples <- unique(dt_ref$SampleName)
  n_sample <- length(samples)
  for(i in 1:n_sample){
    dt_tmp <- dt_ref[dt_ref$SampleName == samples[i]]

    gts <- rep(NA, nrow(dt_tmp))
    for(j in 1:nrow(dt_tmp)){
      gt1 <- c(dt_tmp$Allele1[j], dt_tmp$Allele2[j])
      gt1 <- gt1[!is.na(gt1)]
      gts[j] <- paste0(gt1, collapse = ", ")
    }

    dt_tmp2 <- data.table(Marker = dt_tmp$Marker,
                          Gt = gts)
    names(dt_tmp2) <- c("Marker", samples[i])

    if(i == 1){
      dt_ref_display <- dt_tmp2
    }else{
      dt_ref_display <- full_join(dt_ref_display, dt_tmp2, by = c("Marker"))
    }
  }
  
  n_table_ref <- (n_sample - 1) %/% 5 + 1
  for(i in 1:n_table_ref){
    if(i == n_table_ref){
      samples_display <- samples[(5 * (i - 1) + 1):length(samples)]
    }else{
      samples_display <- samples[(5 * (i - 1) + 1):(5 * i)]
    }
    index_display <- which(is.element(names(dt_ref_display), c("Marker", samples_display)))
    
    tb <- kable(
      dt_ref_display[, index_display, with = FALSE], 
      format = "latex", 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      longtable = TRUE, 
      row.names = FALSE, 
      escape = TRUE, 
      float = FALSE, 
      linesep = ""
    )
    tb <- kable_styling(
      tb, 
      latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), 
      position = "left", 
      full_width = FALSE
    )
    tb <- column_spec(
      tb, 
      1:length(index_display), 
      width = "2.4cm"
    )
    print(tb)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
